name: @padosoft/ecr17
description: The ECR17 (Nexi) payment-terminal protocol as a React-free C++20 library: framing, LRC, commands, parsers, the ACK/NAK session and a money-safe client, plus a Winsock transport for Windows. The native core of @padosoft/react-native-ecr17, usable from native apps (CMake, CocoaPods, Swift Package Manager).
author: padosoft

scripts.test: cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
